rounds.text: Veerhealth Care Ltd (511523) has been under-appreciated based on the evidence provided. The stock currently sits at the upper end of its 52-week range with a P/E ratio of 173.63x, significantly higher than the sector benchmark of 31.86x, indicating that investors may be undervaluing the company's growth potential despite recent strong sales growth (screen reason [E64] and [E65]). Additionally, the company has a compounded profit growth rate of 72% over the trailing twelve months (E21), which is much higher than the sector median of 19.0% (E75). Despite this, the stock's ROCE is at only 7.2%, significantly below the sector benchmark of 12.7% (E77) and the company's own sector median return on equity over the last year of 3% (E29), suggesting that investors may be overlooking the company's profitability issues, as evidenced by screen reason [E69]. These factors collectively imply that Veerhealth Care Ltd is being underappreciated in its current valuation.
